candidate.definition_en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand.
candidate.explanation_ar: حرفة يدوية محتاجة مهارة وفن، زي النجارة أو الخياطة.

senses.definition_en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand or special expertise.
senses.definition_ar: حرفة أو عمل يتطلب مهارة يدوية أو فنية خاصة.
examples: He learned the craft of woodworking from his grandfather.
Writing is a craft that takes years to master.

senses.definition_ar: مركبة للتنقل في الماء أو الجو مثل القارب أو الطائرة.
examples: The captain steered the small craft safely into the harbor.
He learned the craft of woodworking from his grandfather.
Writing is a craft that takes years to master.
The captain steered the small craft safely into the harbor.
candidate.mnemonic: لعبة 'Minecraft'.. فكرتها إنك تبني وتصنع حاجات بمهارة 'Craft'.
